title: Adoption Calibration and Adopter Evidence
rawUserRequest: 继续执行全面整改计划的 WI-04：分离 Runtime Installation、Adoption、Project Calibration、Pilot Work Item、Gate Promotion，建立 fixture/hosted/adopter/not verified 证据矩阵，校正问卷默认值与 Unknown 分类，并完成完整 PR、合并、关闭、分支清理和文档对齐流程。

rawRequestSource.reference: user-request: AI Cockpit comprehensive remediation instruction and continuation authorization

declaredIntent.summary: Make adoption and calibration evidence explicit, typed and fail-closed without turning template or fixture presence into adopter readiness.

outOfScope: Formal Work Item state and Task Outcome integration (WI-07/WI-09)

sources.reason: Canonical shared calibration inventory and evidence status model.
Adoption readiness boundary that consumes explicit evidence.
Inventory status, stale and evidence-kind regression tests.
Calibration session fail-closed and activation boundary tests.
Minimal adopter fixture lifecycle evidence boundary.
Calibration/adoption separation and adopter execution limits.
WI-04 implementation boundary and downstream evidence claim alignment.
Bound WI-04 implementation and verification scope.

riskAssessment.reason: Adoption and calibration claims can be overstated when fixture, hosted, adopter execution and not-verified evidence are conflated or stale.

executionDecision.reason: WI-03 is merged and closed; user authorized serial execution and WI-04 is bounded to calibration/adopter evidence.

preReviewWarnings: Fixture/hosted/adopter/not-verified evidence kinds, defaults, stale handling, and production-readiness non-claims must be reviewed.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: Runtime Installation, Adoption, Project Calibration, Pilot Work Item and Gate Promotion remain distinct lifecycle states; installation alone cannot imply calibration or production readiness.
Every calibration/adopter evidence item declares exactly one evidenceKind: fixture, hosted, adopter_execution, or not_verified; defaults and Unknown/Not Applicable reasons are explicit.
Stale, missing, contradictory or static-only evidence remains non-ready; fixture evidence cannot be used as adopter or hosted evidence.
Inventory, readiness, calibration session and adopter fixture tests pass, and documentation plus full AI/project checks pass before PR creation.
The remediation plan records WI-04 implementation paths, evidence matrix, and downstream claim boundary.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Do not import internal modules from other features.

intent.problem: The current repository has calibration and adoption machinery, but evidence provenance can be read too broadly: static templates or deterministic fixtures can be mistaken for hosted or adopter execution, and installation can be confused with calibration or production readiness.
constraints: Preserve existing calibration session state and fail-closed activation.
Do not claim external provider, identity, object-project or production evidence from local fixtures.
Keep Unknown and Not Applicable distinct and require reasons where applicable.
intent.rationale: A typed evidence-kind boundary lets the inventory and readiness output compress conclusions without overstating what was actually executed or reviewed.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Static template or fixture evidence is not reported as adopter execution or production readiness
Hosted, adopter execution, fixture and not-verified evidence kinds remain distinguishable
Stale, missing, Unknown and Not Applicable evidence fail closed with reasons

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: Set only when a human explicitly approves restricted governance paths.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.
